verdict.rationale: Foreloop's agent reads incoming user feedback and proposes intentions/tasks from it, which is a narrow form of AI-generated insight from data (foreloop-docs-12, foreloop-docs-4), but this is limited to feedback triage rather than broad data analysis or proactive dashboards of insights. Missing for 10: evidence of AI analyzing broader product/business data beyond feedback text, no summarized insights UI, no independent corroboration of insight quality.
